decisions.decision: Manhole repair project: Insituform to start work later this week or next week; Andrew Valliere to keep commission updated
decisions.quote: insituform emailed that they are currently working on other jobs. he is hoping they can start later this week or next week. andrew will keep everyone updated.

decisions.decision: 5 Ramgren Road project approved to be bid out; Bob Proctor awarded work at $4,800 with start next week; work from manhole to property line
decisions.quote: bob proctor had the lowest bid of $4,800, with work starting next week if all goes well. they will be going from the manhole to the property line.

decisions.decision: Sewer budget will not use Retained Earnings to balance this year; User Rate Increase of 16% on User Charges and 5% on minimum charge is necessary
decisions.quote: they will not be using retained earnings to balance the budget this year . the majority of income comes from user charges and pointed out leominster and fitchburg rates are going up. this necessitates a user rate increase of 16% but only 5% increase on the minimum charge.

decisions.decision: 100 Laurel Lane: Commission will attempt to locate sewer stub by digging; if not found, homeowner will be owed a sewer stub
decisions.quote: dan noted it is a pressure line and they will try digging to find the shut-off. andrew added if they cannot find it, they will owe the homeowner a sewer stub.

topics.topic: Rate Increase presentation for Town Meeting
topics.quote: andrew screen-shared bill bernard's slide presentation for the sewer enterprise's article 19 at town meeting. he noted that betterments are shrinking (income) and they will not be using retained earnings to balance the budget this year . the majority of income comes from user charges and pointed out leominster and fitchburg rates are going up. this necessitates a user rate increase of 16% but only 5% increase on the minimum charge.

andrew reported they have a tie-card for the property but they are still trying to find the sewer stub. they did a video inspection but it did not go anywhere. dan noted it is a pressure line and they will try digging to find the shut-off. andrew added if they cannot find it, they will owe the homeowner a sewer stub.

scott asked andrew if he had an update on the project at the old funeral home on mass. ave. and andrew replied he has not seen any updated plans. he also has no update on the potential project at the driving range. andrew reported that there is a buyer for 3 rennie street that wants to fix up the property and connect to sewer.
